    Profile

    Voda is a shaman with the title of Water Sprite - one of the Three Sprites. She was summoned through the power of Ouroboros. Being the eldest of the Three Sprites, she puts everything into making sure to protect Saga for the future.

    Origin: Saga Region
    Gender: Female
    Height: 172cm
    Weight: 62kg
    Birthday: Sept 23
    Blood Type: Type Pa
    Zodiac: Moon of the Ice Water Wolf
    Likes: Fine liquor
    Hobbies: Fashion
    Illust: RINZO
    CV: 佐竹海莉
